title: Poetry
note: Quiet moral reckoning on guilt, beauty, and complicity; deeply humane.

title: La La Land
note: Lovely craft and lingering melancholy ending; thin beneath the homage.

title: Seven Samurai
note: Foundational action grammar, deep humanism; inexhaustible rewatch object.

title: In the Mood for Love
note: Indelible mood and restraint; longing rendered as pure form.

title: Parasite
note: Tight class allegory, controlled tonal shifts; sharp but somewhat schematic.

title: City Lights
note: Final scene indelible; comedy and pathos fused with timeless economy.

title: Spirited Away
note: Boundless invented world; emotion and imagery genuinely persist.

title: The Godfather
note: Tragic moral descent rendered with operatic control; endlessly rewatchable.

title: 12 Angry Men
note: Airtight chamber drama on doubt and prejudice; slightly schematic.

title: A Separation
note: Irreducible moral knot; everyone right and wrong at once.

title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
note: The gaze theorized as cinema; memory and longing burn lingeringly.

title: Moonlight
note: Tender triptych of selfhood; emotion lingers without sentimentality.

title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
note: Reorganizes cinematic time and scale; perceptual landmark, durably enigmatic.

title: The Tree of Life
note: Cosmic-to-intimate prayer; formally daring, genuinely divisive but achieved.

title: Mulholland Drive
note: Dream-logic puzzle that reorganizes narrative; inexhaustible, hauntingly precise.

title: Synecdoche, New York
note: Vertiginous meditation on life as endless rehearsal; bleak, ambitious, divisive.

title: Jeanne Dielman
note: Real-time durational form transforms domestic labor into seismic event.

title: Antichrist
note: Visually arresting grief-horror; provocations sometimes outrun their meaning.

title: Holy Motors
note: Wild ode to performance and cinema's mutations; coherent in its frenzy.

title: Uncut Gems
note: Relentless anxiety machine; superb craft, emotionally exhausting more than deepening.

title: Beau Is Afraid
note: Sprawling anxiety odyssey; bold but bloated, ambition outpacing integration.

title: Close-Up
note: Dissolves fiction and reality; profound inquiry into cinema and identity.

title: Enemy
note: Dread-soaked doppelganger puzzle; controlled, opaque, rewards careful rewatch.

title: Climax
note: Hypnotic formal descent into chaos; sensation-rich but thematically thin.

title: Batman Returns
note: Burton's gothic auteur stamp on a blockbuster; tonally bold, uneven.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
note: Superb practical spectacle; emotionally efficient but conservative and uncomplicated.

title: Ocean's Eleven
note: Effortlessly cool craft and rhythm; durable as pleasure, not substance.

title: Ant-Man
note: Light, competent franchise filler; formula-bound, leaves little behind.

title: John Wick
note: Crisp choreographic action grammar and worldbuilding; durable as kinetic craft.

title: Crazy Rich Asians
note: Glossy crowd-pleaser; representation milestone but narratively conventional and safe.

title: The Hangover
note: Effective comic engine; disposable, coarse, evaporates after the laughs.

title: Jurassic World
note: Self-aware yet hollow legacy spectacle; nostalgia recycled, soullessly manufactured.

title: Knives Out
note: Clever, well-built whodunit with bite; entertaining more than enduring.

title: The Intouchables
note: Warm crowd-pleaser; emotionally effective but reductive and feel-good safe.

title: Free Guy
note: Brisk high-concept comedy; clever premise drowned in corporate slickness.

title: Babylon
note: Maximalist excess about Hollywood; dazzling but exhausting, ambition exceeding control.

title: Cloud Atlas
note: Sprawling reincarnation mosaic; earnest, overreaching, structurally bold yet uneven.

title: The Counselor
note: Bleak philosophical nihilism in McCarthy's voice; mannered, divisive, oddly durable.

title: Joker
note: Magnetic lead, derivative form; borrowed gravitas masking thin provocation.

title: Don't Look Up
note: Blunt satire that flatters its audience; smug, obvious, quickly dated.

title: Star Wars: The Last Jedi
note: Franchise risk-taking genuinely splits fans; thoughtful yet uneven, polarizing.

title: Sucker Punch
note: Style-over-substance overload; claimed critique undermined by its own indulgence.

title: Spring Breakers
note: Neon hypnotic critique of hedonism; formally distinctive, deliberately, divisively slippery.

title: The Fountain
note: Earnest mortality meditation; visually ambitious, emotionally sincere, structurally overreaching, divisive.

title: Southland Tales
note: Chaotic apocalyptic satire; cult-fascinating but incoherent, ambition undisciplined.

title: Suicide Squad
note: Incoherent studio-mangled product; tonal whiplash, cynically assembled, near-empty.

title: Vox Lux
note: Cold portrait of fame and violence; formally bold, deliberately alienating.

title: Avatar: The Way of Water
note: Technical landmark, narrative banality; spectacle achieved but thematically thin.

title: Mamma Mia!
note: Exuberant jukebox confection; technically rough, frothy, joyfully disposable.

title: Now You See Me
note: Flashy misdirection thriller; cheats its own rules, evaporates immediately.
